decisions.reason: The DPA management software fits the firm's agency and compliance strategy, draws positive feedback for its templates, and costs little to maintain, so it is likely to stay.
The configurable managed hosting plan is part of the core hosting business and serves agencies' scalable needs, though it may be renamed or merged into other plans.

Extended PHP security support addresses agencies' real need to secure legacy PHP sites, fits the security and compliance promise, and can earn recurring revenue, though demand shrinks as old PHP versions are phased out.
